root_cause: The AI Modelwijzer exposed an undersized square logo as its Open Graph image. LinkedIn could ignore that asset and choose another larger page/site image, surfacing a personal portrait in the company-page link preview.
prevention: Public money/lead pages must define a large explicit social-preview image.
Company-page previews may not depend on crawler fallback image selection.
AI Modelwijzer social metadata must not reference a personal portrait.
fix: Force the Bedrijfsgeheugen company banner as the Open Graph, image_src and Twitter/X preview image with a cache-busted absolute URL.
